start-here.title: First Animated Sprite
start-here.description: Start a Scene, rotate a Sprite using elapsed time, and click the Sprite to pause or resume it.

start-here.title: Resize and DPR
start-here.description: Handle window resizes and device pixel ratio changes so the canvas stays sharp on high-DPI screens without stretching.

start-here.title: Scene-less App
start-here.description: Run an Application with no Scene at all — a single app-level system drives update and draw directly, loading and rendering a sprite without ever touching Scene.

start-here.title: Orb Dodge
start-here.description: A complete dodge-and-collect loop: move with WASD or arrow keys, collect green orbs for points, avoid red orbs, and restart from the game-over screen.

scenes-assets.title: Scene Switching and Lifecycle
scenes-assets.description: Switch between menu and game scenes with Space and Escape while the screen shows each scene's load, init, activation, update, draw and destroy events.

scenes-assets.title: Loading Progress and Retry
scenes-assets.description: Watch real asset-load progress, retry after a failed request, and revisit already cached assets during a second scene transition.

scenes-assets.title: Asset Catalogs
scenes-assets.description: Declare a typed Assets catalog, merge catalogs with compose, derive one with extend, and load them through two parallel queues with per-queue progress.

scenes-assets.title: Pause Menu
scenes-assets.description: Pause scene updates while a menu appears over the frozen world and an application tween fades in the blur; press Esc or click to resume.

scenes-assets.title: Custom Transition
scenes-assets.description: Write your own SceneTransition: two bars close over the screen, the scene switch commits behind them, then they open again - with the commit/done ordering and the destroy-time resource release the lifecycle contract requires.

scenes-assets.title: Level Loading and Asset Ownership
scenes-assets.description: Load two Tiled rooms with one shared atlas, cancel a pending transition, and inspect the child scopes and atlas claims released on unload.

scenes-assets.title: Cached Assets Offline
scenes-assets.description: Warm an IndexedDB asset source, switch the loader to offline policy, compare a cache hit and miss, then clear and retry.

input-ui.title: Keyboard
input-ui.description: Read key state per-frame and on-event with the Keyboard API. Move a square using the arrow keys.

input-ui.title: Mouse and Pointer
input-ui.description: Track pointer position, button state, and movement delta; fire discrete click and drag events.

input-ui.title: Action Mapping
input-ui.description: Bind keyboard and gamepad controls to one move action and one pulse action, then read both through ActionMap.

input-ui.title: Controller Inspector
input-ui.description: Connect a controller to inspect live stick and button values; see a clear waiting state while disconnected.

input-ui.title: Key Rebinding
input-ui.description: Let players reassign key bindings at runtime and persist the new mapping through a serialisable InputProfile.

input-ui.title: Multitouch
input-ui.description: Track up to ten simultaneous touch points and render each finger as a labelled circle.

input-ui.title: HUD and Widgets
input-ui.description: Build a screen-fixed HUD on scene.ui: anchored score and health widgets, plus a panel of clickable, keyboard-focusable buttons that update them.

input-ui.title: Settings Menu and Focus
input-ui.description: Adjust native sliders, toggles, and dropdowns with pointer, keyboard, or controller focus; save a small settings object.

input-ui.title: Text Entry and Scrolling
input-ui.description: Enter a name and note with native canvas text fields, add it to a list, and scroll through the entries.

input-ui.title: Dialogue and Choices
input-ui.description: Reveal dialogue character by character, skip to the full line, and choose a reply.

input-ui.title: Local Split Screen
input-ui.description: Move two players with separate keyboards or optional controllers while each camera follows its own player.

sprites-cameras.title: Sprite Basics
sprites-cameras.description: Load a texture, create a Sprite, and control position, rotation, scale, and alpha inside a Scene.

sprites-cameras.title: Parent and World Transforms
sprites-cameras.description: Watch a planet and moon inherit rotating Container transforms while a fixed readout compares their local and world positions.

sprites-cameras.title: Pivot and Anchor
sprites-cameras.description: Choose an origin preset and watch the rotating sprite's position, pivot, and bounds change together.

sprites-cameras.title: Blendmodes
sprites-cameras.description: Click through all built-in blend modes applied to an overlapping sprite pair to see how they composite.

sprites-cameras.title: Masks
sprites-cameras.description: Apply a stencil mask to a Container so children only render inside the mask's geometry.

sprites-cameras.title: Texture Sampling and Pixel Snapping
sprites-cameras.description: Compare nearest, linear and mipmapped sampling against a fixed reference while zooming and toggling render-only pixel snapping.

sprites-cameras.title: Camera Navigation and Coordinates
sprites-cameras.description: Pan with WASD or arrows, zoom with the wheel, and place world-space markers while a screen-fixed readout shows pointer coordinates.

sprites-cameras.title: Parallax Layers
sprites-cameras.description: Move the pointer to shift three star layers at different speeds and see depth emerge from their relative motion.

sprites-cameras.title: Picture in Picture
sprites-cameras.description: Embed a secondary scene view inside the main view — classic minimap or security-camera picture-in-picture layout.

sprites-cameras.title: Minimap
sprites-cameras.description: Render a second view of the world into a texture and clip its HUD overlay to a circle.

animation-game-feel.title: Sprite Animation
animation-game-feel.description: Play named spritesheet clips with AnimatedSprite, press Right to switch characters, and press Space to pause or resume.

animation-game-feel.title: Interactive Tweens
animation-game-feel.description: Click to move a Sprite, click again to interrupt its Tween, and press Space to toggle a yoyo round trip.

animation-game-feel.title: Tween Sequences
animation-game-feel.description: Build a looping route from an array of waypoints by chaining Tweens once and restarting the first step after the last completes.

animation-game-feel.title: Easing Explorer
animation-game-feel.description: Use Left/Right or click either side to select any built-in easing function and watch a Sprite trace its large curve.

animation-game-feel.title: Impact Feedback
animation-game-feel.description: Click to flash a sprite, burst particles, and shake the camera as one impact response.

animation-game-feel.title: Fly a Spaceship
animation-game-feel.description: Steer and fire with keyboard or gamepad; collect hits, sparks and optional controller rumble.

animation-game-feel.title: Boss Intro Cinematic
animation-game-feel.description: Tween-driven cinematic sequence with a dramatic boss reveal, screen shake, and synced audio sting.

graphics-text.title: Shapes and Gradients
graphics-text.description: Draw rectangles, circles, polygons, arcs and stars with solid colors plus linear and radial fill or stroke gradients.

graphics-text.title: Text Styles and Fonts
graphics-text.description: Load a custom font and compare it with the default while a styled title demonstrates gradient fill, outline and shadow.

graphics-text.title: Multiline and Wrap
graphics-text.description: Configure word-wrap width, line height, and horizontal alignment for multi-line Text drawables.

graphics-text.title: Bitmap Text Basic
graphics-text.description: BitmapText rendered from an AngelCode .fnt atlas (Kenney Blocks, CC0). Demonstrates pre-built atlas rendering, word wrap, and live text updates without Canvas 2D rasterisation.

graphics-text.title: Mesh Vertices and UVs
graphics-text.description: Compare vertex colors on a custom triangle with UV-mapped texture coordinates on a rotating quad.

graphics-text.title: Mesh Deformed Grid
graphics-text.description: Animate vertex positions on a Mesh grid to produce wave and ripple deformation effects.

graphics-text.title: Mesh Typed Uniforms
graphics-text.description: Declare a mesh material's uniforms once - a nested struct and a mat3 - and let the engine generate the matching GLSL block and WGSL struct for both backends.

effects-rendering.title: Bloom Filter
effects-rendering.description: Add a soft glow to the bright parts of a scene with BloomFilter — sliders drive the luminance threshold, the intensity, how far the glow spreads and how many halvings it takes.

effects-rendering.title: Blur and Drop Shadow
effects-rendering.description: Compare an original sprite with a live blur or offset shadow, adjust each filter, and bypass it.

effects-rendering.title: Color Transforms
effects-rendering.description: Compare the original image with grayscale or sepia matrices, independent 1D channel curves, and a cool 3D LUT.

effects-rendering.title: Retro Display
effects-rendering.description: Tune a combined CRT filter with scanlines, grain, vignette, barrel distortion, and RGB separation; bypass it to compare the clean scene.

effects-rendering.title: Write a Fragment Filter
effects-rendering.description: Move a ripple over a UV grid while one typed uniform schema feeds matching GLSL and WGSL filter shaders.

effects-rendering.title: Metaballs and Filter Order
effects-rendering.description: Drag a blob into moving circles, then reverse or bypass blur and threshold passes to see how filter order changes the result.

effects-rendering.title: Capture a Texture
effects-rendering.description: Compare a live render texture with a frozen snapshot, then click to capture a new frame.

effects-rendering.title: Trail Feedback
effects-rendering.description: Create motion trails by feeding the previous frame back into the current frame with slight fade and blur.

effects-rendering.title: Water Reflection and Distortion
effects-rendering.description: Capture and flip a live reflection, then drag across the water to change the strength of its scrolling displacement map.

effects-rendering.title: Video Drawable
effects-rendering.description: Stream a video element as a live GPU texture and composite it with sprites and filters.

effects-rendering.title: Composable Render Pipeline
effects-rendering.description: Compose named offscreen, optional blur, custom callback, and screen-space HUD passes; toggle blur to compare the live bypass.

effects-rendering.title: Custom Triangle Renderer
effects-rendering.description: Write raw WGSL and wire a custom WebGPU pipeline alongside the built-in renderer — a minimal custom-renderer skeleton.

lighting.title: Normal-Mapped Lighting
lighting.description: Drag a point light across a normal-mapped floor, then vary the active light count from 1 to 48 and watch the draw-call readout.

lighting.title: Shadow Casters
lighting.description: Soft shadows nobody modelled: the walls hand over the rectangle they are drawn as, the cross hands over the outline traced from its alpha channel, and the lightmap renderer shadows every light against them in one draw. Toggle the occluder debug view to see exactly what was collected.

lighting.title: Light Cookies
lighting.description: Four light shapes and two textures doing the work of geometry: window bars and leaf shade are cookies on the lights themselves, a neon tube pools in a capsule rather than a disc, and a sun with no position throws parallel shadows across the whole view.

lighting.title: Normals under the Lightmap Renderer
lighting.description: Forty-five cobbles that nobody authored a normal map for: each one hands the lighting system its own silhouette, a prepass draws the derived normals where the stone sits, and the light field shades against them. Switching the normals off leaves the light exactly as bright.

lighting.title: Radiance Rooms
lighting.description: Radiance cascades against the light-quad renderer on one scene: a single lamp in one of two rooms, a doorway between them, and a switch that rebuilds the lighting system so the same lights can be seen drawn and transported.

particles.title: Emitter Basics
particles.description: Configure a particle emitter — set rate, lifetime, start/end size, colour gradient, and velocity spread.

particles.title: Cursor Attractor Particles
particles.description: Attract and repel particles toward the pointer position using a custom force field on the particle emitter.

particles.title: Fireworks
particles.description: Click to launch a firework rocket that bursts into a radial particle shower at its apex.

particles.title: Campfire
particles.description: Adjust flame intensity and wind while fire and smoke rise from a visible ring of logs and stones.

particles.title: Audio Reactive Particles
particles.description: Emit particles driven by real-time AudioAnalyser frequency data — bass controls density, treble controls spread.

particles.title: Particle Capacity
particles.description: Adjust the spawn rate and watch live occupancy, frame time, and whether particles run on WebGPU compute or the smaller WebGL2 CPU fallback.

particles.title: Custom Wgsl Module
particles.description: Supply a custom WGSL compute module to the GPU particle system to implement non-standard particle behaviour.

audio.title: Play Sound
audio.description: Load a Sound asset and play it on a pointer tap — covers the required user-gesture unlock and basic volume control.

audio.title: Polyphonic Sound
audio.description: Hold Space to play overlapping impacts with varied pitch while a pool meter shows active voices and evictions.

audio.title: Music Loop
audio.description: Play a seamlessly looping music track with live controls for volume, playback rate, and looping.

audio.title: Audio Mixer Buses
audio.description: Route a looping track and click effect to Music and Sound, then mix both through Master with live sliders.

audio.title: Crossfade Tracks
audio.description: Select either looping track and watch its gain indicator follow the scheduled two-second voice crossfade.

audio.title: Reverb and Delay
audio.description: Play one impact through reverb and delay; compare small room, hall, echo, and dry bypass presets.

audio.title: Compression
audio.description: Switch one music source between quiet and loud, bypass the compressor, and read its live gain reduction.

audio.title: Ducking
audio.description: Automatically lower music volume when a sound effect plays — classic game audio ducking via the DuckingFilter.

audio.title: Convolution Rooms
audio.description: Strike one of four materials, panned to where it sits, and cycle through 30 recorded room impulse responses with a right-click, from a few milliseconds of colouration to a half-second cavern.

audio.title: Audio Effect Rack
audio.description: Select one of four distinct effect chains, inspect its order and spectrum, and bypass it against dry output.

audio.title: Vocoder
audio.description: Choose a spoken phrase and compare its dry voice with a vocoder carrier; unlock feedback keeps the first selection visible.

audio.title: Spectrum and Waveform
audio.description: Compare live spectrum bars, a waveform, eight frequency bands, and a beat pulse while playing music.

audio.title: Beat and Tempo
audio.description: Pulse a sprite and particles on detected beats while showing the live BPM estimate, confidence, and onset strength.

audio.title: Spatial Audio
audio.description: Drag or orbit a sound source around a listener, switch distance models, and compare the live pan and attenuation.

worlds-navigation.title: Tilemap Chunks & Layer Bands
worlds-navigation.description: Build a procedural TileMap in code and explore the core @codexo/exojs-tilemap runtime: chunked TileLayerNode rendering, a camera that follows an actor interleaved between TileMapView bands, and the PixelSnapMode cascade.

worlds-navigation.title: Load a Tiled Map
worlds-navigation.description: Load and render a .tmj room, then click highlighted objects to inspect their editor-authored names, types, and properties.

worlds-navigation.title: LDtk World Import
worlds-navigation.description: Load a multi-level LDtk world, switch between its runtime TileMap levels, resolve IntGrid cells to their named/coloured definitions with getLdtkIntGridValueAt(), and read entity fields from the converted ObjectLayer.

worlds-navigation.title: Editor Objects Become Gameplay
worlds-navigation.description: Click an authored switch to open its door, then collect a gem created from the same Tiled object layer by MapObjectSpawner.

worlds-navigation.title: Grid Navigation
worlds-navigation.description: Click to move an agent across a weighted grid: paint walls and mud, toggle jump-point pruning, path smoothing and a 2x2 agent, and watch the expanded-node counter react.

worlds-navigation.title: Editable Map Navigation
worlds-navigation.description: Click to route an agent; switch to wall editing and click a tile to open or close a path while the route updates.

worlds-navigation.title: Paint an Autotiled Room
worlds-navigation.description: Drag to paint or erase grass while Wang neighbor rules choose edge and corner tiles around each edit.

worlds-navigation.title: Tiled Infinite Map Streaming
worlds-navigation.description: Stream a hand-authored Tiled infinite .tmj map: TiledMap.toTileMap() converts each chunked tile layer to an unbounded TileLayer, and a ChunkStreamer per layer pulls chunks from TiledMap.getChunkSource() around a free-flying WASD camera.

worlds-navigation.title: Streamed Terrain
worlds-navigation.description: Explore a deterministic unbounded world, reroll its seed, and compare synchronous and worker-backed terrain sampling at adjustable cost.

physics-collision.title: Rectangles Collision
physics-collision.description: Drag rectangles around the canvas and detect AABB overlap in the update loop — foundational collision recipe.

physics-collision.title: Drag and Throw Physics
physics-collision.description: Drag a body with MouseJoint and release it onto the floor; world.attach keeps its sprite aligned with the simulation.

physics-collision.title: Tiled Collision Map
physics-collision.description: Load an authored .tmj room, build static bodies from its Collision object layer, and toggle outlines while a dynamic actor lands on them.

physics-collision.title: Joint-Driven Shadows
physics-collision.description: Drag a hinged physics arm through a live light and watch its collider reshape the shadow it casts.

performance-diagnostics.title: Interaction Inspector
performance-diagnostics.description: Drag overlapping sprites, change their z-order, and inspect their bounds and hit-test targets.

performance-diagnostics.title: Sprite Batching Laboratory
performance-diagnostics.description: Change visible sprite count and texture diversity within one seeded workload, inspect the performance overlay, and switch between WebGL2 and WebGPU when available.

performance-diagnostics.title: Retained Container
performance-diagnostics.description: Hold a large static sprite field in a RetainedContainer and pan the whole group as a camera: the retained tier replays the subtree as O(batches) with one group-matrix update, while a plain Container walks every child each frame. Toggle the tier and compare the frame-time readout.

performance-diagnostics.title: Immediate-Mode Rendering
performance-diagnostics.description: Draw procedural geometry without a scene graph: gears via drawGeometry and a 2,400-spark field as a single instanced RenderBatch draw call, with a live drawCalls readout.

performance-diagnostics.title: Coroutine Loading
performance-diagnostics.description: Spread world building over frames with a coroutine: a progress-driven loading bar, a share-based frame budget, and cancellation.
